purpose: Maps every expression sample to its fine-grained tissue label. Exists because the atlas's own metadata (COLUMN_LEVEL_sample_metadata.csv) has no field finer than 'tissue', which silently pools leaf_young and leaf_old (46 samples, all study 1) into one 'leaf' bucket -- see docs/DATA_AUDIT.md and MS1_2026/docs/log/20260905_sample_grouping_preflight.md for the incident.
join_key: sample_label, exact string match against data/expr/samples.json's 'label' field
regenerate: the source file above is MS1_2026's own curated panel; re-run the two-line extraction in this sidecar's own generating command if the panel is rebuilt.
